v:
When these story milestones are triggered in the game, this dialogue becomes active for this NPC. Interacting with the NPC will then show this dialogue. You should write distinct  dialogues for different story milestones to make the NPC feel more responsive to the player's progress.

Usually, you only want one milestone per dialogue, but you can assign multiple milestones if you want the same dialogue to be used in different parts of the story.

The "default" milestone is a special milestone that applies when no other milestones are active. You can use it to create a fallback dialogue that will always have something to say, even if you forget to assign milestones to a new dialogue.
